design_description: A minimalist sand-beige design with subtle military and lifestyle influences, built around a clean tonal palette of cream and olive green. The jersey features an all-over repeating Z monogram pattern embedded softly into the fabric, adding texture and identity without disrupting the simplicity of the composition. Olive trims on the collar, sleeves, logos, and crest create a muted tactical contrast that reinforces the understated premium feel. Overall, the design feels calm, modern, and highly wearable — blending football aesthetics with casual streetwear sensibilities.
